units.source_text: 摩诃毘庐遮那即大日如来佛，是密宗佛教的本尊。

en.t: Mahavairocana, also known as the Great Sun Tathagata Buddha, is the principal deity of esoteric Buddhism.
This passage seems to be unfinished.

units.source_text: 据国学家石川雅望说，原本此处大约缺少一行，或损失一纸。

en.t: According to the kokugaku scholar Ishikawa Masamochi, the original text probably lacked about one line here, or perhaps one sheet had been lost.
